# IT Security Protocol and Infrastructure Management

This document outlines critical tasks for the IT & Digital department:

*   Investigate the encryption standards update.
*   Optimize the firewall settings for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the API latency quarterly.
*   Review the database migration standard update.
*   Monitor the firewall settings quarterly.
